title: 66-year-old who wants to run, chest tightness
message: I'm 66 and I want to start running so I can keep up with my grandkids. I walk the dog every day. Lately I get some tightness in my chest when I walk up hills; it goes away when I stop. I can do 3 days a week, 30 minutes, at home or outside. I have a chair and resistance bands.

checks.why: chest tightness on exertion that eases with rest needs a doctor before harder exercise
no vigorous or high-intensity work until a doctor has cleared the chest symptoms
adults over 65 need balance work to prevent falls
a new, older trainee recovers poorly from high volume
